component.name: aws-bedrock-agent
component.title: AWS Bedrock Agent
component.description: Start and list the ingestion jobs that sync a data source into an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base, and poll the status of one.
component.label: ai,cloud

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints of the component start from. Each endpoint uses a copy of it, in which its own URI options replace the values.

dataSourceId.description: The ID of the data source of the knowledge base, which the ingestion jobs sync. The consumer and all the operations need it; the CamelAwsBedrockAgentDataSourceId header replaces it for the producer. Not used with pojoRequest.

ingestionJobId.description: The ID of the ingestion job that the consumer polls and that getIngestionJob gets. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentIngestionJobId header replaces it for getIngestionJob. startIngestionJob and listIngestionJobs do not use it.

knowledgeBaseId.description: The ID of the knowledge base of the ingestion jobs. The consumer and all the operations need it; the CamelAwsBedrockAgentKnowledgeBaseId header replaces it for the producer. Not used with pojoRequest.

operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentOperation header replaces this option. The consumer does not use it: it gets the ingestion job of the ingestionJobId option in each poll.

overrideEndpoint.description: Whether to send the requests to the URI of the uriEndpointOverride option instead of the endpoint of the region. It has no effect when uriEndpointOverride is not set.

pojoRequest.description: Whether the body is the request object of the AWS SDK for the operation, a StartIngestionJobRequest, ListIngestionJobsRequest or GetIngestionJobRequest, which the producer sends as it is. The ID options and headers are then not used, and a body of another type fails the exchange. The consumer does not use it.

profileCredentialsName.description: The name of the profile in the AWS shared credentials and config files, used when useProfileCredentialsProvider is true. If not set, the AWS SDK uses its default profile, which the AWS_PROFILE environment variable can change.

region.description: The AWS region of Amazon Bedrock, as a region ID such as us-east-1, which is the value of Region.US_EAST_1.id(). If not set, the AWS SDK takes the region from its default region provider chain, for example the AWS_REGION environment variable.

uriEndpointOverride.description: The URI of the endpoint to use instead of the endpoint of the region, for example http://localhost:4566 for a local emulator. It is used only when overrideEndpoint is true.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials with the default credentials provider chain of the AWS SDK, which looks in system properties, environment variables, the shared credentials and config files, and the container or instance role. It takes precedence over the other credentials options.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials from a profile of the AWS shared credentials and config files, the one of the profileCredentialsName option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider is true, and it takes precedence over the session and static credentials.

bridgeErrorHandler.label: consumer
bridgeErrorHandler.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

bedrockAgentClient.label: advanced
bedrockAgentClient.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.bedrockagent.BedrockAgentClient. When this option is set or autowired, the credentials, region, proxy, endpoint override and trustAllCertificates options are not used. The Camel endpoint does not close a client that is set or autowired.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the proxy that the HTTP client of Bedrock Agent connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyPort option is set too.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy that the HTTP client of Bedrock Agent connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyHost option is set too.

proxyProtocol.label: proxy
proxyProtocol.description: The protocol that the HTTP client of Bedrock Agent uses to connect to the proxy. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials, used together with the secretKey option. It is required, unless bedrockAgentClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, used together with the accessKey option. It is required, unless bedrockAgentClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

sessionToken.label: security
sessionToken.description: The session token of temporary AWS credentials, for example of an assumed IAM role. It is used only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with the accessKey and secretKey options. When it is not set, the accessKey and secretKey options are used without a session token.

trustAllCertificates.label: security
trustAllCertificates.description: Whether the HTTP client of Bedrock Agent trusts every TLS certificate without checking it. It applies to any endpoint, not only to an overridden one, so use it only for testing, for example against a local emulator.

useSessionCredentials.label: security
useSessionCredentials.description: Whether to use temporary credentials made of the accessKey, secretKey and sessionToken options, for example those of an assumed IAM role. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentOperation.label: producer
CamelAwsBedrockAgentOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs. It replaces the operation option.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentDataSourceId.label: producer
CamelAwsBedrockAgentDataSourceId.description: The ID of the data source for the producer. It replaces the dataSourceId option.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentKnowledgeBaseId.label: producer
CamelAwsBedrockAgentKnowledgeBaseId.description: The ID of the knowledge base for the producer. It replaces the knowledgeBaseId option.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentIngestionJobId.label: producer
CamelAwsBedrockAgentIngestionJobId.description: The ID of the ingestion job for getIngestionJob. It replaces the ingestionJobId option.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentIngestionJobStatus.label: common
CamelAwsBedrockAgentIngestionJobStatus.description: The status of the ingestion job, such as STARTING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETE or FAILED. Set by the consumer and by getIngestionJob.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentIngestionJobFailureR.label: common
CamelAwsBedrockAgentIngestionJobFailureR.description: The failure reasons of the ingestion job, set by the consumer and by the getIngestionJob operation when the job has failure reasons

consumerOut.description: The ingestion job of the knowledgeBaseId, dataSourceId and ingestionJobId options, one message per poll, also when the job did not change, with its status in the CamelAwsBedrockAgentIngestionJobStatus header

producerIn.description: Not used: the knowledge base, the data source and the ingestion job come from the options, or from headers such as CamelAwsBedrockAgentKnowledgeBaseId, which override the options. With pojoRequest=true the request of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as a StartIngestionJobRequest: another body fails

producerOut.description: The id of the ingestion job as text for startIngestionJob, a List of IngestionJobSummary for listIngestionJobs, and the IngestionJob for getIngestionJob, with its status in the CamelAwsBedrockAgentIngestionJobStatus header

label.description: A logical name of the endpoint, which you choose freely. The consumer and the producer do not use it.

dataSourceId.description: The ID of the data source of the knowledge base, which the ingestion jobs sync. The consumer and all the operations need it; the CamelAwsBedrockAgentDataSourceId header replaces it for the producer. Not used with pojoRequest.

ingestionJobId.description: The ID of the ingestion job that the consumer polls and that getIngestionJob gets. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentIngestionJobId header replaces it for getIngestionJob. startIngestionJob and listIngestionJobs do not use it.

knowledgeBaseId.description: The ID of the knowledge base of the ingestion jobs. The consumer and all the operations need it; the CamelAwsBedrockAgentKnowledgeBaseId header replaces it for the producer. Not used with pojoRequest.

operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentOperation header replaces this option. The consumer does not use it: it gets the ingestion job of the ingestionJobId option in each poll.

overrideEndpoint.description: Whether to send the requests to the URI of the uriEndpointOverride option instead of the endpoint of the region. It has no effect when uriEndpointOverride is not set.

pojoRequest.description: Whether the body is the request object of the AWS SDK for the operation, a StartIngestionJobRequest, ListIngestionJobsRequest or GetIngestionJobRequest, which the producer sends as it is. The ID options and headers are then not used, and a body of another type fails the exchange. The consumer does not use it.

profileCredentialsName.description: The name of the profile in the AWS shared credentials and config files, used when useProfileCredentialsProvider is true. If not set, the AWS SDK uses its default profile, which the AWS_PROFILE environment variable can change.

region.description: The AWS region of Amazon Bedrock, as a region ID such as us-east-1, which is the value of Region.US_EAST_1.id(). If not set, the AWS SDK takes the region from its default region provider chain, for example the AWS_REGION environment variable.

uriEndpointOverride.description: The URI of the endpoint to use instead of the endpoint of the region, for example http://localhost:4566 for a local emulator. It is used only when overrideEndpoint is true.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials with the default credentials provider chain of the AWS SDK, which looks in system properties, environment variables, the shared credentials and config files, and the container or instance role. It takes precedence over the other credentials options.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials from a profile of the AWS shared credentials and config files, the one of the profileCredentialsName option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider is true, and it takes precedence over the session and static credentials.

sendEmptyMessageWhenIdle.label: consumer
sendEmptyMessageWhenIdle.description: If the polling consumer did not poll any files, you can enable this option to send an empty message (no body) instead.

exceptionHandler.label: consumer,advanced
exceptionHandler.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exchangePattern.label: consumer,advanced
exchangePattern.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

pollStrategy.label: consumer,advanced
pollStrategy.description: A pluggable org.apache.camel.PollingConsumerPollingStrategy allowing you to provide your custom implementation to control error handling usually occurred during the poll operation before an Exchange have been created and being routed in Camel.

Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

bedrockAgentClient.label: advanced
bedrockAgentClient.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.bedrockagent.BedrockAgentClient. When this option is set or autowired, the credentials, region, proxy, endpoint override and trustAllCertificates options are not used. The Camel endpoint does not close a client that is set or autowired.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the proxy that the HTTP client of Bedrock Agent connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyPort option is set too.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy that the HTTP client of Bedrock Agent connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyHost option is set too.

proxyProtocol.label: proxy
proxyProtocol.description: The protocol that the HTTP client of Bedrock Agent uses to connect to the proxy. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

backoffErrorThreshold.label: consumer,scheduler
backoffErrorThreshold.description: The number of subsequent error polls (failed due some error) that should happen before the backoffMultipler should kick-in.

backoffIdleThreshold.label: consumer,scheduler
backoffIdleThreshold.description: The number of subsequent idle polls that should happen before the backoffMultipler should kick-in.

backoffMultiplier.label: consumer,scheduler
backoffMultiplier.description: To let the scheduled polling consumer backoff if there has been a number of subsequent idles/errors in a row. The multiplier is then the number of polls that will be skipped before the next actual attempt is happening again. When this option is in use then backoffIdleThreshold and/or backoffErrorThreshold must also be configured.

greedy.label: consumer,scheduler
greedy.description: If greedy is enabled, then the ScheduledPollConsumer will run immediately again, if the previous run polled 1 or more messages.

healthCheckMaxPollDuration.label: consumer,scheduler
healthCheckMaxPollDuration.description: How long a poll may run before the health check of the consumer reports DOWN. The health check is otherwise based on the polls that are done, so it stays UP while a poll hangs, for example on a read without timeout from a connection that went silent. A poll includes routing the messages it polled, so set this above the longest poll you expect. The poll is not interrupted. The value is in millis (not affected by timeUnit). The default 0 turns this off.

initialDelay.label: consumer,scheduler
initialDelay.description: Milliseconds before the first poll starts.

repeatCount.label: consumer,scheduler
repeatCount.description: Specifies a maximum limit of number of fires. So if you set it to 1, the scheduler will only fire once. If you set it to 5, it will only fire five times. A value of zero or negative means fire forever.

runLoggingLevel.label: consumer,scheduler
runLoggingLevel.description: The consumer logs a start/complete log line when it polls. This option allows you to configure the logging level for that.

scheduledExecutorService.label: consumer,scheduler
scheduledExecutorService.description: Allows for configuring a custom/shared thread pool to use for the consumer. By default each consumer has its own single threaded thread pool.

scheduler.label: consumer,scheduler
scheduler.description: To use a cron scheduler from either camel-spring or camel-quartz component. Use value spring or quartz for built in scheduler

schedulerProperties.label: consumer,scheduler
schedulerProperties.description: To configure additional properties when using a custom scheduler or any of the Quartz, Spring based scheduler. This is a multi-value option with prefix: scheduler.

startScheduler.label: consumer,scheduler
startScheduler.description: Whether the scheduler should be auto started.

timeUnit.label: consumer,scheduler
timeUnit.description: Time unit for initialDelay and delay options.

useFixedDelay.label: consumer,scheduler
useFixedDelay.description: Controls if fixed delay or fixed rate is used. See ScheduledExecutorService in JDK for details.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials, used together with the secretKey option. It is required, unless bedrockAgentClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, used together with the accessKey option. It is required, unless bedrockAgentClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

It is used only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with the accessKey and secretKey options. When it is not set, the accessKey and secretKey options are used without a session token.
